# DM Games Shop Kenya

> Board game, card game and toy shop in Nairobi CBD, Kenya

DM Games Shop (dmgamesshop.co.ke) sells board games, card games, puzzles and kids' learning toys at Imenti House, Tom Mboya Street, Shop D5 (1st Floor), Nairobi CBD.

## Contact and Location
- WhatsApp: +254797577567
- Email: d.mgamesshop2024@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday 8:30 am to 6:00 pm, Saturday 9:00 am to 6:00 pm
- Delivery: 1 to 2 days within Nairobi, 2 to 4 days for the rest of Kenya. Free delivery on orders of KSH 4,000 and above.
- Payment: Cash and M-Pesa
